The law reader assigns a trimmed source_url or download_url to href and does not allowlist the protocol. Ingested rows have to already be http or https. downloadHref appends a revision query parameter and does not reject javascript:. The research panel is the allowlist: javascript: and data:text/html are not linked, and an https URL with userinfo is not linked. The tests require that body markup stays text and that an https publisher href stays https. They do not require the reader to strip a javascript: source URL.

fetchBundledReaderCorpus requests /corpus/netherlands/current/artifacts.manifest.json and generated/sections.json with cache no-store. It does not inspect response.url or a Location header. Redirect enforcement is on the artifact transport: redirect follow, then an https host allowlist, credentials omit, referrerPolicy no-referrer, and cache no-store. An off-host final URL is unsafe-url. A final /resolve/<revision>/ that differs from the pin is revision-mismatch. A final URL on cdn-lfs.huggingface.co is kept when the bytes match the pin.

Cache field names are compared after underscores and hyphens are removed. query, search, latitude, coordinates, and address are personal-data and are refused before IndexedDB or Cache Storage opens. location_history becomes locationhistory, which is not on that list, and is refused as an unexpected field (invalid) before storage opens. A nested note.query is personal-data. Paths that contain ?, #, .., or a leading slash are invalid.
